title: Layne's Revel Operation Report Exporter
description: Credentials and report settings for the Layne's Revel Operations Report Exporter.

url.title: Revel Operations Report URL
url.description: URL of the Revel Operations report.

username.title: Revel username
username.description: Username used to sign into Revel.

password.title: Revel password
password.description: Password used to sign into Revel.

override_flag.title: Override dates
override_flag.description: When enabled, the Actor uses override_startDate and override_endDate. When disabled, start and end date are both yesterday in US Central Time.

override_startDate.title: Override start date
override_startDate.description: Report start date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Used only when override_flag is true.

override_endDate.title: Override end date
override_endDate.description: Report end date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Used only when override_flag is true.

startTime.title: Start time
startTime.description: Report start time in HH:MM 12-hour format.

startMeridiem.title: Start AM/PM
startMeridiem.description: The current Actor uses AM for the report start time.

endTime.title: End time
endTime.description: Report end time in HH:MM 12-hour format.

endMeridiem.title: End AM/PM
endMeridiem.description: The current Actor uses AM for the report end time.
